name: atom-library
title: Atom Library
description: Named Tailwind-first atom exports for signals, media, inputs, loading states, and layout composition.
useWhen: You are composing a larger control from small visual and semantic pieces.
avoidWhen: You need a complete domain component such as a dialog, table, menu, or card.
responsiveBehavior: Atoms preserve their intrinsic size while composition wrappers respond to available width.
accessibility: Uses native controls where interaction is required.
Decorative atoms are hidden from assistive technology and interactive atoms expose labels or states.

variants.title: Signals
variants.description: Badges, tags, keycaps, dots, indicators, and small status markers.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone for status.

variants.title: Media
variants.description: Avatars, image fallbacks, icon containers, thumbnails, swatches, and aspect frames.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images.

variants.title: Inputs
variants.description: Native fields and input adornments for assembling accessible forms.
accessibility: Keep native labels, focus, and validation relationships in the consuming form.

variants.title: Loading
variants.description: Spinners, progress pieces, skeletons, and activity pulses for transient states.
accessibility: Pair visual loading states with an accessible status announcement.

variants.title: Layout
variants.description: Separators, spacing, surfaces, and small composition wrappers for larger components.
accessibility: Preserve semantic landmarks in the consuming composition.
